name: Obserae — NDR (Network Detection & Response)
description: Integrates Obserae (https://obserae.com), a self-hosted Network Detection & Response platform: a NetFlow/IPFIX collector that reconstructs sessions, builds a cartography of hosts & services, and raises detection alerts. Two modes. LIVE — the Obserae REST API (docs: obserae.com/docs/api-reference): Bearer auth with an `obs_` token, reading GET /api/carto/graph (hosts -> ASSET, listening services -> ASSETSERVICE), GET /api/sessions/riverview (reconstructed flows -> NETWORKSESSION), GET /api/alerts (detection alerts -> XINCIDENT.ALERT, the SOC alert layer, idempotent by source+external_id, with impacted-asset links) and GET /api/status (version/health). OFFLINE — an Obserae cartography+sessions(+alerts) export (YAML or JSON). Network cartography & monitoring surfaces at /network-sessions; detection alerts at /soc. Set OBSERAE_URL + OBSERAE_API_TOKEN in the worker environment for live mode, or pass a 'file' for offline. Python stdlib only.

parameters.name: base_url
parameters.help: Live API mode: Obserae base URL, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8080 (or set OBSERAE_URL). Needs OBSERAE_API_TOKEN (an obs_ Bearer token) in the worker environment.

parameters.name: file
parameters.help: Offline mode: path on the worker to an Obserae cartography + sessions (+ alerts) export (YAML or JSON). Used when no base_url is given. See the connector README for the schema.

parameters.name: max_alerts
parameters.help: Live mode: maximum detection alerts to pull from /api/alerts.

parameters.name: default_protocol
parameters.help: Protocol assumed when a session/service omits it (default tcp).
